statement: Nvidia's CEO held preliminary talks with Korean inference-chip startup Rebellions about a partnership, investment, or acquisition.
why: Nvidia moving on an NPU designer signals that non-GPU inference silicon is becoming a real alternative source of AI compute supply.

impact.mechanism: Absorbing or partnering with an inference NPU vendor adds alternative accelerator supply while blunting a competitive threat to merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang met with Rebellions co-founder and CEO Sunghyun Park at Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters this week to explore possible arrangements with the South Korean AI chip designer, including a technical partnership, investment, or acquisition.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; talks described as preliminary and may not lead to a deal.
